dialogues.speaker: Lianfang
dialogues.text: Tea eggs! Teacakes! Refreshing snacks! Welcome to Lianfang Dim Sum! Simple and convenient specialty foods that you can even enjoy onboard a ship!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me take a look at the menu...

dialogues.speaker: Lianfang
dialogues.text: Choose anything you like!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why do you emphasize "simple and convenient"?

dialogues.speaker: Lianfang
dialogues.text: Oh... It's a long story...

dialogues.speaker: Lianfang
dialogues.text: Chenyu Vale has a leisurely and elegant atmosphere. We locals are used to sitting by the water, brewing a pot of tea with two saucers of beans and two main dishes between us...

dialogues.speaker: Lianfang
dialogues.text: We drink, chat, and enjoy the view, and at the height of our enjoyment, we recite and compose poems! Ah, such freedom!

dialogues.speaker: Lianfang
dialogues.text: They say a gorgeous view complements delicious food, and in such an environment, the tea in one's cup and the food on one's plate becomes exceptionally intoxicating.

dialogues.speaker: Lianfang
dialogues.text: Many traditional dishes in Chenyu Vale were prepared with that in mind.

dialogues.speaker: Lianfang
dialogues.text: But at the end of the day, Yilong Wharf is a commercial port, and foreign visitors wouldn't understand even if we told them.

dialogues.speaker: Lianfang
dialogues.text: The people coming and going through here are only focused on getting their work done quickly and making a killing, so they need working meals that can be finished quickly.

dialogues.speaker: Lianfang
dialogues.text: I've made appropriate improvements to our traditional dishes to satisfy their needs.

dialogues.speaker: Lianfang
dialogues.text: Once they fall for our local cuisine, I'll guide them toward calming down and enjoying a proper meal in an appropriate environment...

dialogues.speaker: Lianfang
dialogues.text: In this way, we can adapt to the trend of commercialization while promoting our traditional cuisine!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You won't get seasick eating onboard?

dialogues.speaker: Lianfang
dialogues.text: That's exactly it!

dialogues.speaker: Lianfang
dialogues.text: Chef Baatjan has improved our cuisine by adding a variety of supplemental ingredients while maintaining the dishes' original taste...

dialogues.speaker: Lianfang
dialogues.text: These supplemental ingredients greatly alleviate the symptoms of seasickness experienced by our diners, so they naturally feel better!

dialogues.speaker: Lianfang
dialogues.text: Some repeat customers even pay us a special visit before boarding to purchase some refreshments. They say that even the worst winds and waves are nothing to fear while they have our victuals in hand. It's great, right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Come again next time...

dialogues.speaker: Lianfang
dialogues.text: We look forward to serving you again!
